title: spec(object-extension `fields`): the record key is a bare z.string(), so `fields: { 'Region Code': … }` parses and is refused only downstream
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmSduNGC2SZXszyrNut

Filing gate: ② an out-of-scope finding the #29366 dev reported on PR #29513 (os-dev-report 6583545776) and the seat's contract review confirmed (record 6583861239). ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

## What happens

PR #29513 keys `ObjectExtensionSchema.fieldPatches` by the field-name key schema `ObjectSchema.fields` uses (`FieldNameKeySchema`, unexported, in `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`). The sibling member `ObjectExtensionSchema.fields` (the fields an extension ADDS, `object.zod.ts:5036` at PR #29513's head `6a70094d`) is still keyed by a bare `z.string()`, so `fields: { 'Region Code': { … } }` parses at the schema. That is the same class as #29366 and #28655 item B.

## Done when

`ObjectExtensionSchema.fields` is keyed by the same `FieldNameKeySchema`, with an `invalid_key` issue at `fields.KEY` and a prescription. As on #29366, first measure which doors accept such a key end to end (`defineStack`, the save door, the boot fold, `os validate`); if any does, it is `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` / `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, BREAKING, with an ADR-0087 semantic entry and a `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES` detector.

Serial: lands after PR #29513 (same file and the same key schema).

Related: #29366 / PR #29513, #28655 / PR #29331.
